status: Local native inspection lifetime fixed and verified; no production deployment or SDK/runtime publication in this increment.

environment.runtime: Native Alchemy workerd, R2 and Queue on local Linux

failure.operation: R2 get of an admitted process receipt while the Worker publishes its cancellation
failure.observedResult: Native get returned null although head found the object with an ETag.
failure.simulatorTrace: The installed simulator found object metadata, then blob.get returned null. That branch raises NoSuchKey, implemented as status 404 / provider code 10007.
failure.cause: The fixture opened one local bucket store in the application Worker and again in its outer platform-proxy Worker. These independent workerd instances shared disk metadata/blobs but not blob reader lifetimes. The writer removed an overwritten blob while the second instance was still reading it.
failure.beforeFix: The 32-read disposal regression failed in the tracked cancellation test. Repeated expanded runs also failed after 1, 10 and 16 sandbox admissions.

resolution.resourceOwner: Only the application Worker binds the local R2 bucket. Node inspection uses native PlatformProxy.connect against the native handler in that same Worker.

dependencyPatch.surface: Exports the existing native platform-proxy Worker handler plus declarations emitted from that source by TypeScript. No custom binding codec or bucket implementation is introduced.
dependencyPatch.types: Native incoming Request and inferred handler declarations are retained.
dependencyPatch.removal: Remove when the resolved Alchemy runtime exports an equivalent embeddable platform-proxy handler; switch both fixture imports in that cutover.

resolution.storageImplementation: An attempted per-instance reader reference guard did not solve cross-instance ownership and was removed. The native R2 implementation remains unchanged.
resolution.authorization: The embedded handler uses the provider's native protocol and a fresh per-runtime token. Missing and incorrect tokens both returned 401.
resolution.isolation: Two separate native runtimes with identical bucket/key names retain separate contents.

verification.frozenInstall: bun install --frozen-lockfile passed with the declared patch.

regression.result: Passed; every fetched body is decoded and disposal retains cancellation/output/authority checks.

expandedStress.description: Temporary expansion of the same disposal seam to sixteen rounds of all three runtimes; native execution, storage and Queue delivery remain real.

verification.completeGate: bun run check passed: runtime/SDK build, TypeScript, workspace Clippy and Cargo tests, then native Bun tests.
verification.format: bun run format:check passed; final evidence files formatted with the same native formatter.
verification.cleanup: Temporary native provider instrumentation was removed; the delivered dependency patch contains only the public export and generated declarations.

limits: This fixes the Boxes local inspection harness; it is not evidence of an R2 production storage defect.
No retries, fake storage responses or timing grace periods were added to hide missing objects.
Stress and suite durations are verification observations, not production latency or cost benchmarks.
Minutei code/deployment, production deployment and published SDK/runtime archives were not changed.
The broader AgentOS parity gates remain open.
